title: Phone will not charge
symptom: Company phone does not charge when plugged in
user_description: I plug my work phone in overnight and the battery is still flat in the morning.

options.why: Erases all data and is a drastic step for a charging fault. Never start with it.

options.text: Check the cable and adapter, try another cable and socket, and look for dirt in the charging port
options.why: Damaged cables, faulty adapters and lint in the port are the most common causes. Swapping parts one at a time finds which one it is.

options.text: Open the phone and replace the battery
options.why: Risky and not an L1 task. Never open a device before simple checks.

hints: What carries power from the wall to the phone?
How can you test the cable, adapter and port one by one?
real_world_tip: A different cable and a different adapter is the quickest test. Mixed-up cables cause a lot of 'charging' tickets.

physical_steps.action: Take a spare charging cable to try
